title: Discover
headline: Understand the business, the buyer and the systems.
description: Stakeholder conversations, analytics review, technical audit and a documented baseline.

title: Strategy
headline: Choose the work that matters most.
description: Prioritized roadmap, scope, success measures, responsibilities and dependencies.

title: Build
headline: Deliver in visible increments.
description: Agreed sprint cadence, working demos, acceptance criteria and issue tracking.

title: Launch
headline: Release with a clear go/no-go decision.
description: Functional, accessibility, security and performance checks; deployment and rollback plan.

title: Optimize
headline: Turn evidence into the next decision.
description: Reporting on an agreed cadence, experiment backlog and prioritization review.
